read.thesis: Homebuilder cut FY26 closings to 83,800-84,300 and revenue to $32.5-33.0B as cancellations rose to 20%, while margin was protected via lower stick-and-brick costs; supply discipline is visible in owned lots down 13% and inventory held flat.

capex.quote: we're buying less raw dirt in the most recent quarters than we have in a while

triggers.label: FY26 closings cut to 83.8k-84.3k
triggers.quote: homes closed by our homebuilding operations of 83,800-84,300 homes

triggers.label: Cancellation rate 20% vs 17% a year ago
triggers.quote: Our cancellation rate for the quarter was 20%, up from 17% in the prior year period

triggers.label: Owned lots down 13% year over year
triggers.quote: Our own lot position is down 13% from a year ago.

triggers.label: Backlog price up YoY, mostly mix
triggers.quote: I think that's largely a function of mix.

guidance.quote: we now expect consolidated revenues of approximately $32.5 billion-$33 billion
homes closed by our homebuilding operations of 83,800-84,300 homes
We expect our home sales gross margin for the fourth quarter to be in the range of 20.5%-21%
still expect operating cash flow of at least $3 billion
common stock repurchases of approximately $2.5 billion
we currently expect our rental inventory to remain around $3 billion

red_flags.label: Cancellations up to 20%, qualification-driven
red_flags.quote: qualification is still largely the biggest reason for cans

red_flags.label: Buybacks exceeded year-to-date cash flow
red_flags.quote: Our year-to-date spend on repurchases has been in excess of our cash flow year to date.

evasions.quote: Right now, we don't really have visibility to any upside to any large extent on our current year repurchases.
